name: Drakkar
action: On its turn, the drakkar can take two actions, choosing from the options below (it can take the same action multiple times). It can take only one action if it has fewer than 40 crew. It can't move or take actions if it has fewer than 3 crew.

items.name: Fire Ballista
items.entry: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d10 + 8}) Piercing damage.

items.name: Row
items.entry: The drakkar takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} action.

items.name: Volley
items.entry: Archers release a volley of arrows at a point within 600 feet. Creatures within 30 feet of that point must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. Creatures that fail the saving throw by 5 or more have their {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} reduced by 10 feet until the start of the drakkar's next turn.

items.name: Shield Wall
items.entry: The rowers raise their shields in defense. This grants creatures in the ship a +5 bonus to their {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} and Dexterity Saving throws, but the ship's current {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved until the end of the next round.

other.name: Sails and Rowing
entries: While in {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, the drakkar's listed {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is its sailing speed. Reduce this in half when sailing against the wind. When rowing, a drakkar's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 20 ft.

other.name: Initiative
entries: The drakkar has an {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} modifier of +4.

name: Ogre War Sled (pulled by two Worgs)
action: On its turn, the driver of the war sled may use one of the following actions in place of its normal actions

items.name: Sled Trample
items.entry: The sled moves at least 30 feet in a straight line. Each creature trampled by the sled must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 2d10} Bludgeoning and {@damage 2d10} Slashing damage, and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and does not have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Worg Attack
items.entry: The sled moves at least 10 feet in a straight line, ending adjacent to a creature or object. The two {@creature Worg|XMM|Worgs} pulling the sled may each make one attack against the target. If both {@creature Worg|XMM|Worgs} hit with their attacks, the driver may also make one melee weapon attack against the target.

other.name: Bulky Construction
entries: Creatures that aren't Large must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling|XPHB}) each turn to control the sled in battle. On a failure, the sled moves its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} in a random direction (other than backward).

other.name: Mounted Vantage
entries: Passengers on a moving war sled have a +2 bonus to weapon damage rolls against creatures not also on a mount or vehicle.

other.name: Skull Shield
entries: Large creatures riding on the war-sled have {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} from ranged attacks.
